Alexandre Pierre.note: Pierre's edge is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required.
Alexandre Pierre.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是提前站位后的快速反应。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。

Carl Sainte.note: Sainté is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Carl Sainte.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Carlens Arcus.note: Arcus's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Carlens Arcus.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Danley Jean Jacques.note: Jacques stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Danley Jean Jacques.noteZh: 他的突出特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Derrick Etienne.summary: Derrick Etienne Jr. is a Haiti winger who plays for Toronto FC and gives the national team direct carrying, left-side width, and transition speed.
Derrick Etienne.note: Jr is defined by making purposeful movement away from the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Derrick Etienne.noteZh: 他靠用有目的的无球移动创造接应点与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Dominique Simon.note: Simon stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Dominique Simon.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Duckens Nazon.note: Nazon stands out for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Duckens Nazon.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Frantzdy Pierrot.club: Çaykur Rizespor (on loan from AEK Athens)
Frantzdy Pierrot.note: Pierrot's signature is giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Frantzdy Pierrot.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Garven Metusala.note: Metusala's edge is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Garven Metusala.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Hannes Delcroix.note: Delcroix is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Hannes Delcroix.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Jean-Kevin Duverne.note: Duverne's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Jean-Kevin Duverne.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在比防线早一步看到决定性的传球上。他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Jean-Ricner Bellegarde.note: Bellegarde's signature is creating a better angle for the next pass. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Jean-Ricner Bellegarde.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在为下一脚传球制造更好的角度上。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Johny Placide.note: Placide's edge is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He waits for the strike before committing. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Johny Placide.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是提前站位后的快速反应。他会等到对方触球前再做扑救选择。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Josue Casimir.note: Casimir's signature is making purposeful movement away from the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Josue Casimir.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在用有目的的无球移动创造接应点上。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Josue Duverger.note: Duverger stands out for staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Josue Duverger.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Keeto Thermoncy.note: Thermoncy stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Keeto Thermoncy.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Lenny Joseph.note: Joseph stands out for starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Lenny Joseph.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Louicius Deedson.note: Watch Deedson for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Louicius Deedson.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。留意他如何提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Markhus Lacroix.note: Lacroix's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Markhus Lacroix.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Martin Experience.note: Expérience is defined by recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Martin Experience.noteZh: 他靠第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Ricardo Ade.note: Adé's signature is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Ricardo Ade.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在危险出现前组织好队友上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Ruben Providence.note: Providence stands out for explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Ruben Providence.noteZh: 他的突出特点是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Wilguens Paugain.note: Paugain is defined by pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Wilguens Paugain.noteZh: 他靠带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Wilson Isidor.note: Isidor stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Wilson Isidor.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Woodensky Pierre.note: Pierre is defined by choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Woodensky Pierre.noteZh: 他靠选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Yassin Fortune.note: Fortuné stands out for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Yassin Fortune.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。
